X02,2026-05,750,600
X03,2026-05,,25
Y01,2026-06,1300,950
Y02,2026-06,400,440
Y03,2026-06,300,90
Z01,2026-07,2000,1200
Z02,2026-07,1000,700
Z03,2026-07,500,
"""

# 从字符串读取（模拟数据）
from io import StringIO
raw = pd.read_csv(StringIO(RAW_CSV), dtype={'order_id': str, 'month': str})
raw['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(raw['revenue'], errors='coerce')
raw['cost'] = pd.to_numeric(raw['cost'], errors='coerce')

print("=" * 60)
print("【模拟数据声明】以下订单为公开模拟数据，非真实经营数据。")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"原始记录数: {len(raw)}")

print(f"\n[去重] 重复记录数(按 order_id 保留首条): {dup_count}")
print(f"[去重] 被删除的重复 order_id: {dup_ids}")

missing_count = int(missing_mask.sum())
missing_ids = dedup.loc[missing_mask, 'order_id'].tolist()
print(f"\n[缺失] 收入或成本缺失被剔除的订单数: {missing_count}")
print(f"[缺失] 被剔除的 order_id: {missing_ids}")
print("[缺失] 说明: 缺失值直接剔除，绝不用 0 冒充真实收入/成本。")

neg = clean[clean['gross_profit'] < 0]
print(f"\n[负毛利] 保留的负毛利有效订单数: {len(neg)}")
if len(neg) > 0:
    print(f"[负毛利] 负毛利 order_id: {neg['order_id'].tolist()} (按规则保留，不剔除)")

# ============ 输出 clean.csv ============
clean = clean[['order_id', 'month', 'revenue', 'cost', 'gross_profit']].reset_index(drop=True)
clean.to_csv('clean.csv', index=False, encoding='utf-8-sig')

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print(f"清洗后记录数: {len(clean)}  (原始 {len(raw)} - 重复 {dup_count} - 缺失 {missing_count})")
print(f"落盘文件: clean.csv")
print("=" * 60)
print(clean.to_string(index=False))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤2：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总，输出 monthly_summary.csv
注意：本步骤只读取前序产物 clean.csv，不重新生成原始数据。
数据性质：模拟数据（非真实公司经营数据）。
金额单位：元。
"""
import os
import sys
import pandas as pd

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 输入契约校验 ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] 缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤拒绝重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[INFO] 读取 {INPUT_FILE}：{len(clean)} 行，列={list(clean.columns)}")

required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] clean.csv 缺少必要列：{missing_cols}")

# ---------- 2. 防御性检查（规避已知陷阱） ----------
# 陷阱1：重复订单重复计数 —— 检查 clean.csv 是否已去重
dup_cnt = int(clean.duplicated(subset=["order_id"]).sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中重复 order_id 行数 = {dup_cnt}（应为 0，前序步骤已去重）")
if dup_cnt > 0:
    print("[WARN] 检测到重复 order_id，按规则保留首条后再汇总。")
    clean = clean.drop_duplicates(subset=["order_id"], keep="first")

# 陷阱2：收入/成本缺失用 0 冒充 —— 检查缺失
na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中 revenue 缺失 = {na_rev}，cost 缺失 = {na_cost}（应为 0）")
if na_rev or na_cost:
    print("[WARN] 存在缺失，按规则剔除缺失订单后再汇总。")
    clean = clean.dropna(subset=["revenue", "cost"])

# 类型与数值健全性
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="coerce")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="coerce")
if clean["revenue"].isna().any() or clean["cost"].isna().any():
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 数值转换后仍存在缺失，数据不可用。")

# 陷阱3：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单 —— 显式保留并统计
clean["gross_profit"] = clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]
neg_orders = int((clean["gross_profit"] < 0).sum())
print(f"[CHECK] 毛利为负的有效订单数 = {neg_orders}（按规则保留，不剔除）")

# ---------- 3. 按 month 汇总 ----------
# 陷阱4：平均单笔毛利率造成加权错误 —— 用总毛利/总收入，而非订单毛利率均值
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "count"),
)
grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入（加权口径）
grp["gross_margin"] = grp.apply(
    lambda r: (r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]) if abs(r["revenue"]) > TOL else float("nan"),
    axis=1,
)

# 列名严格为：month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]].copy()
monthly = monthly.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 4. 核对：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计 ----------
sum_rev = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_gp = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())
sum_orders = int(monthly["orders"].sum())

det_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
det_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
det_gp = float(clean["gross_profit"].sum())
det_orders = int(len(clean))

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev - det_rev) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost - det_cost) <= TOL
ok_gp = abs(sum_gp - det_gp) <= TOL
ok_orders = sum_orders == det_orders

print("\n[VERIFY] 月度汇总之和 vs 清洗明细合计（绝对容差 1e-8）")
print(f"  revenue : 汇总={sum_rev:.6f} 明细={det_rev:.6f} -> {'PASS' if ok_rev else 'FAIL'}")
print(f"  cost    : 汇总={sum_cost:.6f} 明细={det_cost:.6f} -> {'PASS' if ok_cost else 'FAIL'}")
print(f"  gross_profit: 汇总={sum_gp:.6f} 明细={det_gp:.6f} -> {'PASS' if ok_gp else 'FAIL'}")
print(f"  orders  : 汇总={sum_orders} 明细={det_orders} -> {'PASS' if ok_orders else 'FAIL'}")

if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_gp and ok_orders):
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 汇总核对未通过，拒绝写出 monthly_summary.csv。")

# 毛利率口径复核：总毛利 / 总收入
overall_margin = sum_gp / sum_rev if abs(sum_rev) > TOL else float("nan")
print(f"[VERIFY] 整体毛利率（总毛利/总收入）= {overall_margin:.6f}")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[OUTPUT] 已写出 {OUTPUT_FILE}（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))

"""
步骤2：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总，输出 monthly_summary.csv
注意：本步骤只读取前序产物 clean.csv，不重新生成原始数据。

金额单位：元。

import os
import sys
import pandas as pd

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 输入契约校验 ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] 缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤拒绝重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[INFO] 读取 {INPUT_FILE}：{len(clean)} 行，列={list(clean.columns)}")

required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] clean.csv 缺少必要列：{missing_cols}")

# ---------- 2. 防御性检查（规避已知陷阱） ----------
# 陷阱1：重复订单重复计数 —— 检查 clean.csv 是否已去重
dup_cnt = int(clean.duplicated(subset=["order_id"]).sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中重复 order_id 行数 = {dup_cnt}（应为 0，前序步骤已去重）")
if dup_cnt > 0:
    print("[WARN] 检测到重复 order_id，按规则保留首条后再汇总。")
    clean = clean.drop_duplicates(subset=["order_id"], keep="first")

# 陷阱2：收入/成本缺失用 0 冒充 —— 检查缺失
na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 中 revenue 缺失 = {na_rev}，cost 缺失 = {na_cost}（应为 0）")
if na_rev or na_cost:
    print("[WARN] 存在缺失，按规则剔除缺失订单后再汇总。")
    clean = clean.dropna(subset=["revenue", "cost"])

# 类型与数值健全性
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="coerce")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="coerce")
if clean["revenue"].isna().any() or clean["cost"].isna().any():
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 数值转换后仍存在缺失，数据不可用。")

# 陷阱3：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单 —— 显式保留并统计
clean["gross_profit"] = clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]
neg_orders = int((clean["gross_profit"] < 0).sum())
print(f"[CHECK] 毛利为负的有效订单数 = {neg_orders}（按规则保留，不剔除）")

# ---------- 3. 按 month 汇总 ----------
# 陷阱4：平均单笔毛利率造成加权错误 —— 用总毛利/总收入，而非订单毛利率均值
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "count"),
)
grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入（加权口径）
grp["gross_margin"] = grp.apply(
    lambda r: (r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]) if abs(r["revenue"]) > TOL else float("nan"),
    axis=1,
)

# 列名严格为：month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]].copy()
monthly = monthly.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 4. 核对：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计 ----------
sum_rev = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_gp = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())
sum_orders = int(monthly["orders"].sum())

det_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
det_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
det_gp = float(clean["gross_profit"].sum())
det_orders = int(len(clean))

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev - det_rev) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost - det_cost) <= TOL
ok_gp = abs(sum_gp - det_gp) <= TOL
ok_orders = sum_orders == det_orders

print("\n[VERIFY] 月度汇总之和 vs 清洗明细合计（绝对容差 1e-8）")
print(f"  revenue : 汇总={sum_rev:.6f} 明细={det_rev:.6f} -> {'PASS' if ok_rev else 'FAIL'}")
print(f"  cost    : 汇总={sum_cost:.6f} 明细={det_cost:.6f} -> {'PASS' if ok_cost else 'FAIL'}")
print(f"  gross_profit: 汇总={sum_gp:.6f} 明细={det_gp:.6f} -> {'PASS' if ok_gp else 'FAIL'}")
print(f"  orders  : 汇总={sum_orders} 明细={det_orders} -> {'PASS' if ok_orders else 'FAIL'}")

if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_gp and ok_orders):
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 汇总核对未通过，拒绝写出 monthly_summary.csv。")

# 毛利率口径复核：总毛利 / 总收入
overall_margin = sum_gp / sum_rev if abs(sum_rev) > TOL else float("nan")
print(f"[VERIFY] 整体毛利率（总毛利/总收入）= {overall_margin:.6f}")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[OUTPUT] 已写出 {OUTPUT_FILE}（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))
